PANW.text: Free cash flow was $4.1 billion in FY2026: operating cash flow of $4.6 billion less capital spending of $440 million (computed from two filed figures). That is 35.8% of revenue. In FY2021 it was $1.4 billion.
Stock-based compensation was $1.8 billion in FY2026, 15.5% of revenue, against 21% in FY2021.
In FY2026 the company paid $1 billion to repurchase its own shares. No dividend payment is tagged for the year.
In the three months ended 2026-10-31 revenue was $3.4 billion, up 39.2% from $2.5 billion in the three months ended 2025-10-31.
Over the four quarters to 2026-10-31 revenue added up to $12.5 billion (computed from five filed figures), operating income to $482 million and net income to $455 million.
Free cash flow over the same four quarters was $4.3 billion: operating cash flow of $4.7 billion less capital spending of $443 million (computed from ten filed figures).

The proxy statement filed 2026-10-27 gives the principal executive officer’s total pay for FY2026 as $80.3 million in its summary compensation table, and the “compensation actually paid” - the SEC’s measure, which revalues share awards over the year - as $814 million.
For the other named executive officers the same table gives an average of $16.1 million in total and $101 million actually paid.
The table puts the value of $100 held in the company’s shares over the years it covers at $498.93 at the end of FY2026, and $252.91 for the peer group the company chose.

Remaining performance obligations - revenue under contract that was not yet recognised - were $21.2 billion at the end of FY2026, against $15.8 billion a year earlier. That is 184.7% of FY2026 revenue (computed from two filed figures).
Deferred revenue was $7.7 billion at the end of FY2026 (tagged ContractWithCustomerLiabilityCurrent), against $6.3 billion a year earlier.
The latest annual report gives the workforce as 21,921 in its own words. FY2026 revenue works out to about $524,000 for each (computed from one filed figure and the number in that sentence).

At the end of FY2026 the balance sheet carried $2.5 billion in cash and cash equivalents and $557 million in short-term investments, and $1.8 billion of debt as tagged (ConvertibleDebtNoncurrent). Cash and short-term investments exceeded that debt by $1.3 billion (computed from three filed figures).
